description: Tired of carrying a separate water dish on every walk? This portable water cup has a built-in drinking bowl, so your dog can drink right from the cup without an extra dish. The container is leak-proof, so water stays out of your bag. It has a stainless steel body and a comfortable wrist strap that makes it easy to carry on daily walks, travel, hiking, and park visits. It is lightweight, so it adds little bulk to your walk gear. The listing names it a small dog water bottle. Keep one in the car, in your bag, or by the door so it is ready for your next outing. Its simple design makes it an easy add to the walk routine. Each order includes one water cup.
